Local surface-acquisition compatibility patch:
- Present valid suboptimal textures rather than discarding every frame.
- Reconfigure mismatched extents after presenting and request another frame.
- Retry transient surface acquisition failures instead of losing pending content.
- Emit optional debug diagnostics for surface acquisition.
